authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 8201 subsection 6 *pilīla explicitly gives Kalasha pilīlyak, Palula pilīlu and Bashkarik pilīl; Shina has ph- in the same branch. Selected long pilil forms retain that diagnostic repeated-l stem, with aspiration, vowel length and endings qualified. Turner warns of taboo variation and imperfect grouping across the overall family; local transmission remains unresolved. Exact response: pīlīlak.
